description:
## What it does

Official Colombian Tasa Representativa del Mercado (USD/COP) from Superintendencia Financiera (datos.gov.co dataset mcec-87by), served as prepaid x402 JSON on Base USDC.

## Best for

- Agents that need the official Colombian peso FX print, not a synthetic mid-market rate.
- Settlement, invoicing, and COP-denominated pricing workflows.

## Endpoints

- `GET /trm` — current official TRM USD/COP with validity window and source.

## Code usage

Unpaid GET returns HTTP 402. Pay $0.005 USDC on Base (`eip155:8453`, exact + EIP-3009).

```bash
curl -sS -D- https://x402.lagaceta.net/trm
```
